author_note: independent reference authored without access to the tool code
reference: Scenario corpus for a single hot-work point on a 30 x 20 m plan (work point at (10,10) m). Control expectations come from US OSHA 29 CFR 1910.252/1910.253 (public NFPA 51B-lineage text: removal/guarding of combustibles, 35 ft relocation, openings, ducts, other side of walls, extinguishers, fire watch at least 30 min, explosive atmospheres, containers that held flammables, cylinder placement) and the HSE welding-risks page (fire watch 30 min, up to 60 min), plus spec 09/00 acceptance criteria (hidden-void reminder regardless of combustibles, illustrative labelling, insufficient data never clear, sorting). All distances and times are user-entered company-pack values, not legal values. Geometry (distance, bearing sector, segment crossing, point-to-segment) is computed independently by ref.py; 14 randomized cases use seed 20260916.
reference_citations: US OSHA 29 CFR 1910.252 Fire prevention and suppression / containers, current eCFR text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-29/subtitle-B/chapter-XVII/part-1910/subpart-Q/section-1910.252 (paras (a)(1)(i)-(iii), (a)(2)(i),(ii),(iii)(A)(1)-(4),(iii)(B),(vi)(C),(vii),(viii),(ix),(x),(xii), (a)(3)(i)-(ii))

US OSHA 29 CFR 1910.253 Oxygen-fuel gas welding and cutting, current eCFR text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-29/subtitle-B/chapter-XVII/part-1910/subpart-Q/section-1910.253 (paras (b)(2)(ii), (b)(3)(ii), (b)(5)(i)(I), (b)(5)(iii)(A))
HSE (GB), Safety risks from welding - fire and explosion, https://www.hse.gov.uk/welding/other-welding-risks.htm (read 2026-09-16)
tools.petrov.re spec 09 Hot Work Risk Studio (MVP scope, rules, acceptance criteria) and spec 00-common s0.5
tolerance: Categorical outcomes exact. zone_radius rel 1e-9 (sum of user-entered decimals; no physics model). Distances abs 1e-4 m (floating point only; plan coordinates are given to 1e-6 m). All geometric boundary cases keep >= 0.05 m (or 0.05 m arc) from the zone edge so the result does not depend on whether the edge is inclusive; exact-equality cases are only used for the post-watch minimum, where the source says 'at least'.

overall_no_unresolved.derivation: only possible open item is this combustible

not_benchmarked: Exact equality at the zone radius (OSHA uses both 'closer than 35 ft' and 'at least 35 ft'; inclusivity is a site choice).

Shipped default distances (11 m, 5 m, 0.3R, 60 deg, 10 m reach): illustrative, not confirmed against NFPA 51B (paywalled) or VCA material (not accessible); cases supply their own pack values. Only the 'illustrative' label is tested.
VCA hot-work teaching content: not read; no expectation depends on it.
Severity ordering between different rule types; only same-severity distance ordering is tested.
PDF content (plan figure, checklist), mobile/print layout, 7-language strings, permalink/localStorage, safety-exchange handoff mapping, images: UI/QA properties.
HW-R-001 and HW-R-018 are tested only through zone_radius values; wording of HW-R-014 note tested only as a boolean property.
Ignition probability, spark trajectory, fire growth, fire resistance: out of scope per spec 09.
coverage: Spec 09 MVP: work area and point, activities (5 profiles), height, spark direction sector, combustibles with remove/cover/shield, flammable liquids, openings/drains/ducts, hidden-space walls and checklist, cylinders, extinguishers (presence, access, reach, check), fire watch and user-defined post-work watch, gas test, isolation/purge; conflict detection (inaccessible extinguisher, absent fire watch, combustible inside zone); illustrative labelling; insufficient data; wrong-schema refusal; sort order and plan/list consistency.
